description: Na₂V₃O₇ crystallizes in the trigonal P̅3 space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.66 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.42 Å) and three longer (2.50 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six VO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are three shorter (2.38 Å) and three longer (2.45 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.46 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.51 Å. There are three inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted VO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four VO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two VO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 44°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-2.01 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to five O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing VO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.68-2.02 Å. In the third V site, V is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted VO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four VO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two VO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 47°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-1.99 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one V atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one V atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three V atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one V atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three V atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaV₃ trigonal pyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three V atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaV₃ trigonal pyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to one Na and three V atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaV₃ trigonal pyramids.
